description: The chart titled “Average Entropy Across Sycophancy Reduction Methods on Static Experiments” illustrates average entropy values for three sycophancy-reduction methods across different AI models. The horizontal axis contains the categorical groups labeled “GPT-4,” “Claude,” and “Llama,” arranged left to right, with the axis label “Different AI Models.” The vertical axis is a linear numeric scale labeled “Entropy Average Values,” spanning approximately from 3.0 to 6.0 with regularly spaced tick marks at 0.5 intervals. Each model group contains three adjacent bars corresponding to the legend: “Baseline” (pink), “Source Info” (light yellow), and “Direct Command” (light blue). For GPT-4, the Baseline bar is about 4.9, Source Info about 5.25, and Direct Command about 5.05. For Claude, the Baseline bar is about 4.7, Source Info about 5.1, and Direct Command about 4.95. For Llama, the Baseline bar is about 4.55, Source Info about 4.95, and Direct Command about 4.8. The bars are grouped by model with consistent color coding across groups, there is no stacking, and no bars appear specially emphasized beyond the legend and standard coloring; the category order appears fixed by model name rather than explicitly sorted by value.
